title: Grandmother’s Quilt
lesson: Start by identifying what is known and what must be found in the situations from ‘Grandmother’s Quilt’. Explore perimeter, then connect it to length around shapes and rectangular arrangements. Before accepting an answer, estimate or reason about its size, then explain why the method is valid.
